To my LOML,

Happy birthday to one of the sweetest people in my life. ♡ I'm genuinely grateful that our paths crossed. Even through a screen, you've become someone whose presence can make an ordinary day feel a little brighter.

I hope this new year of your life brings you peaceful days, genuine happiness, beautiful memories and all the little things you've been wishing for. I hope you always know how loved and appreciated you are.

Keep being exactly who you are. Keep laughing at the dumbest things, keep dreaming big and keep making your own little corner of the world brighter.

Here's to another year of us, more conversations, more memories, more random moments and so many reasons to smile. I hope life is extra gentle with you this year. You deserve the prettiest things. 🫶🏻
